title: Save my history and Save my measurements are never checked while busy, empty or blocked
what: No test sees the button say 'Saving…' or refuse a second tap, the grey 'Nothing to save yet' lines, the demo line on Save my history, or the 'Sharing isn't available' line. Nothing checks that old export files from earlier days are cleared.
expected: A phone test taps each button on an empty phone, on demo data and twice quickly, and reads each line.
fix_line: Add a short phone run for the empty, demo and double-tap cases of both buttons

title: Save a backup: the empty, demo and full-phone cases are never seen, and no test checks the gym key stays out of the file
what: No test reads 'Nothing to back up yet', the sample member line, the space-needed line or the 'Couldn't save the backup' line. The round-trip test checks only that the phone number does not come back; nothing checks that the gym membership, the gym link key or an AI key are left out of the file the member shares.
expected: A test opens a saved file from a phone joined to a gym and finds no phone number, gym key or AI key in it; the refusals are read on screen.
fix_line: Assert the saved file holds no phone, gym key or AI key, and read the refusal lines on screen

title: Erasing a signed-in phone is checked only by reading the code, never by running it
what: The three-choice 'What do you want to erase?' question is never opened by a test. That a failed account delete erases nothing is checked only by finding two lines of code in the right order, so it would still pass if the guard stopped working. Nothing checks that signing in again after a full delete brings nothing back.
expected: A test runs the erase with the account delete failing and finds the phone unchanged, and runs it with the delete working and finds nothing comes back on sign-in.
fix_line: Run the erase with a fake account that fails and one that works, and check the phone after each

title: The 'Notifications are off' row for gym reminders has no test at all
what: No test blocks notifications and looks for the gym 'Notifications are off for MettleUp' row, or checks it goes once allowed. The gym reminders caption ('at 9:30 am. Never more than one a day.') and most of the 'Messages from my gym' caption are never checked. The only blocked-notifications phone test is for workout reminders.
expected: A phone test with notifications blocked sees the gym row and its words, then sees it gone after allowing.
fix_line: Add the gym reminders page to the blocked-notifications phone run

title: After a member leaves, no test checks their phone number, shared workouts and messages are gone from the gym
what: Server tests check the leaderboard rows, the trainer summary and a challenge result's number go when a member leaves. None checks the member's own record, shared workouts or messages, or the mobile number on the gym's member list, though the promise says they go.
expected: A server test leaves a gym and finds no phone number, shared workout or message of that member left for the gym to read.
fix_line: Extend the leave test to the member record, shared workouts and messages
